questions.q: Which country launched DHRUV64, a 1.0 GHz, 64-bit dual-core microprocessor?
questions.explain:
India's first indigenous semiconductor is 'DHRUV64'.
Dhruv-64 is an indigenously developed 64-bit semiconductor processor designed in India to support secure, high-performance computing for strategic and civilian applications, developed under national self-reliance initiatives by C-DAC.
C-DAC - Centre for Development of Advanced Computing.
